snippet.description:

ラングリッサー ドラマティック・イディッション [シナリオ 1]
Warsong is reborn in this dramatic Sega Saturn remake of Langrisser I. Prince Ledin (aka Garett) must flee before Baldea falls.

(Special thanks to: Mr. D, TeknoZX, Moon Knight, & EricKei for partial english translations and edits)

セガ  サターン (full playthrough - no commentary)

Game by NCS/Masaya (1998)

#LangrisserRemake #DramaticEdition #Warsong
